response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), overall AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - overall.avg_match_count) AS avg_excess_match_count FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall WHERE g.match_count > overall.avg_match_count
